message.resonant_industry.configured: Blueprint installed. Aim a wrench at the controller to preview; use the wrench to assemble.
message.resonant_industry.configure_busy: Disassemble and empty items, liquids and reserved fuel before changing blueprints.
message.resonant_industry.unbound: This port is not connected to an assembled machine.
message.resonant_industry.unformed: Machine disassembled. Inventory and progress remain in the controller.
message.resonant_industry.unloaded: A structure chunk is unloaded; the machine is paused.
message.resonant_industry.fluid_rejected: Wrong liquid, insufficient room, or less than one bucket available.
message.resonant_industry.inventory_full: Make room for the filled bucket.
guide.resonant_industry.intro.title: Resonant Industry: Getting Started
guide.resonant_industry.intro.body: Craft a controller, blueprint and wrench. Use a blueprint on an empty controller. Aim a wrench to preview, use it to assemble, or sneak-use to disassemble while preserving inventory and progress. Burn coal, process biomass with water, then centrifuge slurry into reagents and fuel residue.
guide.resonant_industry.generator.title: Fuel Generator 3x3x3
guide.resonant_industry.generator.body: Coal/charcoal: 64 FE/t for 1600 ticks. Condensed biomass lasts 800 ticks; fuel residue 400. Insert fuel through I; E exports energy. Fuel pauses when the buffer is full.
guide.resonant_industry.processor.title: Biomass Processor 3x4x3
guide.resonant_industry.processor.body: 1 mycelium bundle, spore pod or condensed biomass + 1000 mB water -> 1000 mB slurry in 160 ticks at 16 FE/t. W takes water; F exports slurry; I accepts biomass.
guide.resonant_industry.centrifuge.title: Industrial Centrifuge 3x3x5
guide.resonant_industry.centrifuge.body: 1 glass bottle + 1000 mB slurry -> 1 separated reagent + 1 fuel residue in 200 ticks at 24 FE/t. Tissue samples instead yield purified tissue. O exports both products.
guide.resonant_industry.transport.title: Transport and Storage
guide.resonant_industry.transport.body: Cables move energy; an energy cell actively outputs at its front. Pipes connect W/F; tanks actively output at the front. Put a powered pump above water: up to 1000 mB/second, 100 FE/bucket. Two adjacent source blocks preserve vanilla renewable water. Use buckets to fill or drain.
guide.resonant_industry.assembly.title: Assembly, Saves and Integration
guide.resonant_industry.assembly.body: Legend: # casing, C controller, R spindle, G glass, E energy, I item inlet, O item outlet, W fluid inlet, F fluid outlet, dot air. Layers start at the bottom, with the controller at the front. Four rotations are supported. Structure damage, unloaded chunks, no power or full outputs pause processing.
guide.resonant_industry.processes.title: Multi-input processes
guide.resonant_industry.processes.body: Centrifuge: put 2 bottles in I1, 1 paper in I2, and coal/charcoal in the first catalyst slot. Fluid I1: 1000 mB slurry; I2: 1000 mB water. 32 FE/t for 240 ticks yields 2 reagents, 1 residue, 500 mB water in O1 and 250 mB slurry in O2. Catalyst retained. Sneak-use a fluid port with an empty hand to select channels 1–4. Outputs must fit; inputs are consumed on completion.
lab.resonant_industry.vessel_help: Empty: sample. Filled: dispense. Sneak: sample one dose; sneak in air: change dose.
lab.resonant_industry.blocked: Blocked: check fluid, contents, room and dose.
guide.resonant_industry.labware.title: Labware · Sampling and measured doses
guide.resonant_industry.labware.body:
Capacities (mB): reagent bottle 250, dropper bottle 100, pipette 25, test tube 50, beaker 1000.
Use a vessel on an empty bench position to place it. A water bucket fills a beaker. On a vessel or tank: empty tools sample; filled tools dispense one dose. Sneak to sample one dose; sneak in air to change dose.
Empty hand opens the bench: choose source, target and dose, then Transfer. Sneak with an empty hand retrieves a vessel. Breaking the bench drops filled vessels. Different liquids or chemical components cannot mix.
guide.resonant_industry.chemistry.title: Lab equipment · Extraction
guide.resonant_industry.chemistry.body:
Place a beaker or test tube in #1 and liquid reagent in #2. Use the right panel for solids and fuel. Click Start. The heater needs coal or charcoal. Power the stirrer with a redstone signal.
Empty beaker + dried kelp on the heater makes alkali ash.
250 mB water + apple in the stirrer yields fruit acid extract.
250 mB water + alkali ash in the stirrer yields alkaline extract.
guide.resonant_industry.experiments.body:
Measure 25 mB fruit acid into #1 and at least 25 mB alkaline extract into #2. The stirrer makes 50 mB neutral solution and keeps the unused reagent.
Move 50 mB neutral solution to heater slot #1 to evaporate it into salt crystals.
Or stir 50 mB neutral solution with a raw tissue sample to obtain purified tissue and 50 mB nutrient slurry.
chemistry.resonant_industry.distill_help: Place the condenser to the right of the heater as you face it. Face both devices the same way. Put a vessel in condenser slot #1.
guide.resonant_industry.filtration.title: Separation · Filtration
guide.resonant_industry.filtration.body:
Stir 25 mB fruit acid with a calcite block to make 25 mB calcium extract. Stir that sample with 25 mB alkaline extract in #2 to form 50 mB suspension.
Put suspension in filter slot #1, a receiving beaker or test tube in #2, and filter paper in the right panel. Start to recover calcite and 50 mB clear filtrate.
guide.resonant_industry.distillation.bod:
Facing the heater, place a condenser against its right side. Face both devices the same way and put a receiving vessel in condenser slot #1.
Use 50 mB filtrate or neutral solution in heater slot #1. Add coal or charcoal and press Distill. Processing starts at 100°C.
Collect 40 mB distilled water and keep 10 mB concentrate in the heated vessel. A full receiver pauses the batch. Distilled water works in fruit and alkali extraction.
